about_the_game:
Experience a taste of Neanderthallica in this demo: a prehistoric puzzle-metroidvania with a surprising sci-fi edge. Even within a single biome, you'll discover the power to manipulate the weather, dramatically altering the environment and your approach to combat. Experiment with a diverse range of gear and weapon parts to forge your own unique builds. Solve intriguing puzzles, uncover secrets hidden within this ancient world, and get ready for a humorously engaging adventure. Can you master the elements and the challenges that await?

Key Features (Demo):

  • Manipulate the Weather: Even within a single biome, change conditions to influence the environment and combat.

  • Craft Gear and Weapons: Discover and combine a variety of parts to tailor your approach to challenges.

  • Solve Puzzles: Utilize weapons and weather strategically to overcome obstacles.

  • Uncover Secrets: Explore the demo's environment to find hidden items and lore.

  • Experience the Blend: Enjoy the unique mix of prehistoric and sci-fi elements.

  • Lighthearted Adventure: Immerse yourself in a humorous and engaging narrative.
